def clean(df):
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.lower()
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].sum().reset_index()
    return dict(df.values.tolist())
